name: LangMem
description: Open-source Python library from LangChain that gives agents long-term memory: extract and consolidate memories, memory tools for the hot path, and LangGraph store support.

skills.name: Manage Memory Tools
skills.description: Give an agent tools to record and search memories during a conversation, persisted in LangGraph's store.

skills.name: Extract Memories in Background
skills.description: Automatically extract, consolidate and update an agent's knowledge from conversations in the background.

skills.name: Optimize Agent Prompts
skills.description: Refine one or several agent prompts from conversation feedback so behavior improves over time.
